question: The mode of the observations 24, 33, 32, 24, 28, 24, 29, 25, 25, 34, 27, 26, 22, 34, 27, 24 and 30 is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Mode** is defined as the observation that appears **most frequently** in a data set.

By scanning the data: **24** appears 4 times, while 25, 27, and 34 appear only 2 times each.

All other numbers (22, 26, 28, 29, 30, 32, 33) appear only once.

Since **24** has the **maximum frequency**, it is the mode of the given observations.

**∴ The correct answer is 24.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Observations = 24, 33, 32, 24, 28, 24, 29, 25, 25, 34, 27, 26, 22, 34, 27, 24, 30

**Formula:** Mode = Value with the highest frequency.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4b26e0d324b86ffdaea8560c2e49832924bbc15ca653f35677f25771f76e50e6.png] 

To find the mode, we construct a **frequency table** for the given data:

⇒ Frequency of 22 = 1

⇒ **Frequency of 24 = 4**

⇒ Frequency of 25 = 2

⇒ Frequency of 26 = 1

⇒ Frequency of 27 = 2

⇒ Frequency of 28 = 1

⇒ Frequency of 29 = 1

⇒ Frequency of 30 = 1

⇒ Frequency of 32 = 1

⇒ Frequency of 33 = 1

⇒ Frequency of 34 = 2

⇒ Comparing all frequencies, the **maximum frequency** is 4.

⇒ The observation corresponding to the maximum frequency is 24.

**∴ The correct answer is 24.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Empirical Formula

For a moderately skewed distribution, the relationship between mean, median, and mode is: **Mode = 3 × Median − 2 × Mean**.

Types of Data Sets

A data set with one mode is **unimodal**. If it has two modes, it is **bimodal**, and if it has more than two, it is **multimodal**.

Median Calculation

To find the **Median**, arrange data in ascending order. If n is odd, Median = ((n+1)/2)th term. If n is even, Median = Average of (n/2)th and (n/2 + 1)th terms.</p
